fields.System.Title: INB-401 — Record a discrepancy against a receipt line
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a receiving clerk, I want differences between expected and actual recorded as
discrepancies, so that supplier problems are visible instead of absorbed by the warehouse.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a short, over, or damaged receipt, then a discrepancy record is created
  • automatically with type, quantity, and reason.
  • - Given a discrepancy, then it links to the receipt line, the ASN line, and the supplier.
  • - Given open discrepancies, then they can be listed by supplier and by date.
  • - Given a discrepancy, then it can be closed with an outcome — credited, replaced,
  • accepted, written off.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound |
| Tables | discrepancy, receipt_line |
| Risks | Supplier shortfalls absorbed as warehouse loss |
| Tests | unit · integration |
